text:
You're not looking for a woman. You're looking for your mother.

She's older, dominant, familiar. But you're not attracted to her. You're haunted by what you didn't get.

Your brain learned: love means chasing someone who won't be captured. So you pick women built to recreate that specific wound.

The psychological truth: A healthy man is attracted to feminine, younger women. A man still bleeding from a mother wound chases older, dominant women.

Stop waiting for her to fix what your mother broke. It's your job.
caption:
The discipline you show in work means nothing if your mindset about women is built on mother wounds.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
